name: Astrology Scholar Study
body:
Associated Skill Knowledge (planes) (Int)

Basic Study Ability
Astrological Embodiment (Ex)

By researching your own life story’s place among the destiny writ in the esoteric constellations, you learn to embody your personal astrological sign. Choose any one of the following constellations. As these are occult signs, the constellation you choose is not dependent upon the stars you were born under, but upon the alignment of the planes at the moment of your birth. Once chosen, your constellation cannot change.

You can apply the benefits of your chosen constellation as a swift action, gaining a bonus or a special ability, as the animal aspect class feature of the hunter class.

You can use this ability for a number of minutes per day equal to 1 + 1/2 your ranks in Knowledge (planes). This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments.

The Angel: You gain a +2 competence bonus to Heal checks and to checks made to stabilize when you are below 0 hit points. When you reach 8th level, these bonuses rise to +4, and at 15th level, they rise to +6.
The Beast: Choose unarmed strike or any one type of natural weapon; you gain a +1 bonus on damage rolls when making attacks of this type. This bonus increases to +2 when you reach 8th level, and +3 at 15th level.
The Dark Beyond: You gain a +4 competence bonus on Bluff checks. When you reach 8th level, this bonus rises to +6, and at 15th level, it rises to +8.
The Dragon: You gain a +4 competence bonus on Intimidate checks. When you reach 8th level, this bonus rises to +6, and at 15th level, it rises to +8.
The Fiend: You gain a +1 competence bonus to the DCs of any spells or effects that you use with the evil, fear, or poison descriptors. When you reach 8th level, these bonuses rise to +2, and at 15th level, they rise to +3.
The Hero: You gain a +4 competence bonus on Acrobatics checks. When you reach 8th level, this bonus rises to +6, and at 15th level, it rises to +8.
The Mage: Pick one school of magic. You gain a +1 competence bonus to the DC of any spell or spell-like ability you cast from this school. When you reach 8th level, choose a second school of magic to apply this benefit to. At 15th level, choose a third school of magic.
The Noble: You gain a +1 luck bonus on saving throws against charm, compulsion, and fear effects. This bonus increases to +2 when you reach 8th level, and +3 at 15th level. You can activate this bonus as a reaction instead of a swift action, but you must still use the benefits of your astrological embodiment ability in 1-minute increments.
The Scholar: You gain a +2 competence bonus on Knowledge checks made to identify the lore and qualities of creatures. When you reach 8th level, this bonus rises to +4, and at 15th level, it rises to +6.
The Seer: You gain a +4 competence bonus on Perception checks. When you reach 8th level, this bonus rises to +6, and at 15th level, it rises to +8.
The Skull: You gain a +1 competence bonus to the DCs of all death effects that you inflict upon your enemies, and to all rolls to confirm critical hits. When you reach 8th level, these bonuses rise to +2, and at 15th level, they rise to +3.
The Thief: You gain a +4 competence bonus on Sleight of Hand checks. When you reach 8th level, this bonus rises to +6, and at 15th level, it rises to +8.
The Tree: You gain a +4 competence bonus on Survival checks. When you reach 8th level, this bonus rises to +6, and at 15th level, it rises to +8.
Associated Technique
Fated Technique (Ex)

If an opponent you have studied with this ability threatens a critical hit on any attack against you, or a critical fumble on any attack against you from a square threatened by you, that opponent suffers a –1 penalty on the confirmation roll. At 3rd level and every 3 levels thereafter, this penalty increases by 1, to a maximum penalty of –7 at 18th level.

Once this ability is triggered, any remaining duration for your technique ability against this opponent immediately ends, regardless of the outcome of the confirmation roll.

Advanced Study Abilities
Fortuitous Evasion (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Astrological Embodiment study ability, scholar level 2nd.

From reading the stars, you have learned to foretell moments of great danger and predict how to avoid them. A number of times per day equal to your Intelligence bonus (minimum 1), you can choose to take only half damage from a failed saving throw, or no damage from a successful saving throw that would normally have a reduced effect on a successful save. Using this ability does not require an action, and you may decide to use it after you roll the saving throw. Note that this ability applies to any kind of damage effect, including hit point damage, nonlethal damage, ability damage, and so on—but not to effects that do not cause damage, such as mind-affecting effects, slow effects, and so on. If you negate the damage from an effect, other consequences from a failed saving throw may still apply.

Fortune/Misfortune (Su)

Prerequisite(s): Astrological Embodiment study ability, scholar level 4th.

You gain the Fortune and Misfortune hexes, using your ranks in Knowledge (planes) as your effective witch level. Each use of either hex requires the expenditure of 1 point of inspiration. Once a creature has been affected by either hex, they cannot be affected again for 24 hours.

Natural Divination (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Astrological Embodiment study ability, scholar level 2nd.

You gain the natural divination ability, as the revelation of the same name from the oracle’s nature mystery. You can use natural divination (in any combination) once per day plus one additional time per day for every 4 ranks you have attained in Knowledge (planes).

Star Prophecy (Su)

Prerequisite(s): Astrological Embodiment study ability, Knowledge (planes) 5 ranks, scholar level 5th.

Once per night, while the stars are visible, you can enter a trance while studying them to gain a glimpse of the future. This trance lasts for 1 minute, which must be uninterrupted and during which you can take no other actions. You gain the benefits of an augury spell with 90% effectiveness. If you are at least an 8th level scholar with at least 8 ranks in Knowledge (planes), you instead gain the benefits of a divination spell with 90% effectiveness. If you are at least an 11th level scholar with at least 11 ranks in Knowledge (planes), the knowledge gained is equivalent to a commune spell.

None of these spell effects require material components.
